correctness.rationale: Local single-flip energy is exact and sign gauge handles negative rung couplings. Discordant rungs propagate cyclically and survive exactly when the nonzero rung magnitude is smaller than twice the leg coupling; aligned rungs give the exhaustive no-singletons/all-words dichotomy. Circular run compositions and transfer matrix have exact arithmetic; 54 full-Hamiltonian enumeration cases and 28 complete polynomial checks passed. The Perron-root and exponential-moment arguments prove the infinite-volume claims, not numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: The uniform-coupling frozen ladder is physically motivated by the 2005 Glauber study. The natural anisotropic rung sweep yields a complete finite-size, energy-graded landscape classification, an arbitrarily weak-coupling singularity and an increase of blocked-state entropy as ferromagnetic rung strength passes twice the leg strength. The wall-density jump is a structural indicator for blocked-state ensembles, not a routine isolated small graph count.
